tools.description:
Returns the weather forecast (daily temperature, rain, and a
    frost_risk flag per day) for a field or place over the next N days.
    location can be a field_id such
    as "field-1" or a place name. Always call this tool for any question
    about weather, forecasts, rain, or frost risk; never answer weather
    from memory.
tools.name: get_weather_forecast

tools.description:
Returns planting and harvest windows for a crop in a given region.
    Use when the user asks when to plant or harvest a specific crop.
tools.name: lookup_crop_calendar

tools.description:
Returns the crop, status and region for a given field_id. field_id must match
the format "field-<n>", e.g. "field-1" or "field-2".
tools.name: query_field_status

tools.description:
Logs a pending task for a field. Use when the user wants to record
    a future action like irrigating, fertilizing, or inspecting for a given field_id. field_id must match
the format "field-<n>", e.g. "field-1" or "field-2".
tools.name: log_task

tools.description: Returns all tasks currently pending across all fields.
tools.name: get_pending_tasks

rvec.description: Rodrigues rotation vector [rx, ry, rz] in radians (axis * angle) -- this is what cv2.solvePnP / ArUco pose estimation return directly, not Euler angles
rvec.title: Rvec

tvec.description: Translation vector [tx, ty, tz] in meters
tvec.title: Tvec

tools.description:
Sends a 6D target pose (translation + Rodrigues rotation vector) to
    the C++ motor-control real-time loop. Use when the user wants the robot
    to move to, reach for, or orient itself toward a specific spatial
    target -- not for anything about crops, weather, or farm-task logging.
tools.name: submit_spatial_intent

tools.description:
Returns the robot's current physical joint angles, read from the
    motor-control loop's live telemetry. Use when the user asks about the
    robot's current pose, joint positions, or whether it has reached a
    target -- not for anything about crops, weather, or farm-task logging.
tools.name: read_joint_states
